members.name: #seen
members.default: new MutationObserver((records) => { for (const record of records) { const tag = record.target if (record.type !== 'attributes' || !(tag instanceof Element) || !tag.hasAttribute('pressed')) continue for (const other of this.#buttons()) if (other !== tag) other.removeAttribute('pressed') } this.#sync() })

declarations.description:
Many records in one card: view tabs, a toolbar with search, filter chips and sort, a table whose rows
can be ticked, and a pager. Below 600 px each row is a card; a cell's `card` attribute (`title`,
`status`, `aside`, `body`, `end` or `meta`) places it there, and a cell with none stays out of the card.
The parts are told apart by their tags: `e-tabs`, `e-table`, `e-empty-state` and `e-pagination` take a
row each, and every other child sits in the toolbar.
declarations.name: EIndexTable

slots.description: The app's parts in order: `e-tabs`, the toolbar controls, `e-table`, `e-empty-state` and `e-pagination`.
A removable filter chip (`slot="filter"`, with a `name`). The script adds its remove button.
slots.name: filter

slots.description: The actions for ticked rows (`slot="bulk"`). While rows are ticked they take the toolbar's place, after the count.
slots.name: bulk

events.name: e-selection-change
events.description: A row or the head checkbox changed the number of ticked rows. `detail` is `{ count }`.

events.description: A filter chip was removed. `detail` is `{ name }`, the chip's `name` attribute.
